ov: اتصل بإم للقتل (الإنجليزية: Dial M for Murder) هو فيلم جريمة إثارة أمريكي من إخراج ألفريد هتشكوك وبطولة راي ميلاند، غريس كيلي، روبرت كامينغز، أنتوني داوسون وجون وليامز. صدر الفليم في 29 مايو 1954.
plotEn:
Tony Wendice, a retired English professional tennis player, is married to wealthy socialite Margot, who has been having an affair with Mark Halliday, an American crime-fiction writer. Tony secretly knows about the affair and plots Margot's murder to inherit her fortune, fearing a divorce would leave him penniless.
Charles Swann, formerly Tony's Cambridge University classmate, has a criminal record that Tony is well aware of. Tony invites Swann to his Maida Vale flat on a pretext, and  confides Margot's affair. He reveals that six months earlier he had stolen Margot's handbag, containing a love letter from Mark, and had anonymously blackmailed her. Tricking Swann into leaving fingerprints on the letter, Tony threatens to expose him as the blackmailer unless he agrees to kill Margot.
With the added inducement of £1,000 in cash, Swann agrees to the murder Tony has plotted. Tony and Mark are to attend a party, while Margot stays home alone. At an agreed  time, when Margot is in bed, Swann is to enter the building and open the flat's front door with Margot's latchkey, which Tony will have hidden on the hall staircase under the carpet. When Tony telephones from the party, Swann is to kill Margot as she answers the call. He is then to stage a burglary-gone-wrong, and put the key back under the staircase carpet as he leaves.
